title: different size action bar and no "menu" button in the "settings" submenu...
symptom: The user reports that the action bar in the "Settings" and "Find notes" submenus has a different size and there is no "Menu" button in the "Settings" submenu. They suspect these submenus use a custom action bar and ask how to install a standard action bar.
evidence_quote: As a perfectionist, I tried to find how to change the action bar in the "Settings" and "Find notes" submenus. In addition, there is no "Menu" button in the "Settings" submenu.
